question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Glimpse
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glimpse"** means to see something or someone for a very short time or only partly. (झलक)

 
 
• **Example: **She caught a** glimpse** of the actor as he left the theater.
 
 
 
• **"Glance"** refers to taking a quick or brief look at something. (झलक)
 
 
• **Example: **He **glanced **at his watch to check the time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct** synonym** of** 'glimpse' **is **'Glance.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Examine** (जाँच करना): To inspect or scrutinize something carefully.

 
 
• **Example:** The doctor **examined** the patient thoroughly.
 
 
 
• **Stare** (टकटकी लगाकर देखना): To look at someone or something for a long time without moving the eyes.
 
 
• **Example:** She **stared **at the painting, lost in thought.
 
 
 
• **Observe** (देखना): To watch someone or something carefully in order to gain information.
 
 
• **Example:** Scientists **observe** animal behavior to understand their habits.
